entry.title: End-to-End NTT on FPGA for FHE Acceleration. Fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) enables privacy-preserving computation on encrypted data without decryption.
entry.summary:
Fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) enables privacy-preserving computation on encrypted data without decryption. Despite its strong security guarantees, FHE incurs substantial computational and memory overhead. In FHE-based deep learning inference, on average 63% of the CPU time is spent on the number theoretic transform (NTT) and its inverse (INTT), which reduce the complexity of polynomial multiplication from $O(N^2)$ to $O(N \log N)$.
